headlines.how: Conservatives had 2% of the vote in 2020
headlines.why: Conservatives rated best on cost of living

lines.result: The party's first majority since 1928, after nine years of NDP government.
lines.majority: Their margin over the NDP was 10.7 points, against 1.6 points the other way in 2024.
lines.how: In 2024, they took the BC Liberals' place as the NDP's main rival.
lines.where: Conservatives were elected in 28 of 34 suburban ridings, up from 15 in 2024.
lines.who: On average, ridings at every income level moved toward the Conservatives.
lines.middle: Three of every four seats the Conservatives added were in these ridings.
lines.why: It was the top worry, and ratings were about even on the other two.
lines.promises: The Conservative platform's answer to each top worry.
